Dear mr Завальнюк,

We are sorry that you had this impression of our clinic, but we would like to clarify that your treatment was not conducted in the way described in your review.

You came to our clinic with gastrointestinal complaints and partial previous medical documentation. To avoid unnecessary costs, we did not repeat tests that were already available, and only the additional diagnostics considered necessary for a proper medical evaluation were recommended.

Your therapy was adjusted, and during your follow-up visit you reported improvement and stated that the prescribed treatment had helped. Later, you returned with new acute symptoms, for which further diagnostics and therapy were recommended in accordance with current medical standards and guidelines. At the following control visit - you again reported significant improvement.

Regarding the elevated blood sugar value, lifestyle recommendations were provided, including diet modification and smoking cessation, as these are the first-line measures in preventing progression toward diabetes.

Our goal is always to provide medically justified diagnostics and treatment, with the patient’s health and safety as the absolute priority. We are sorry that our approach was perceived differently, but we are glad to hear that you are feeling better now and we wish you good health.

Kind regards,
Milmedika Porto Montenegro
